title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3703 North Main Street in Farmville, North Carolina, as the Walter B. Jones, Jr. Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3703 North Main Street in Farmville, North Carolina, as the "Walter B. Jones, Jr. Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a North Carolina post office in Farmville after former Representative Walter B. Jones, Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3703 North Main Street in Farmville, North Carolina, as the Walter B. Jones, Jr. Post Office. It changes only the name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 3, 2020.
